lucas: Throwing this into the channel -- quick heads-up: KestrelX13B int4 shows weird early decay on storybench when switching tokenizers.

maya: details? what tokenizer swap and what does decay look like?

lucas: baseline tokenizer was kestrel-spm-v2, we tried replacing with unified-bpe (to match qwen intake). After ~1.2k tokens generation collapses to short repeating clauses, like 5-8 token loops.

frank: could be rotary freq mapping mismatch when model originated from mistral-like freqs and we applied qwen/pytorch conversion. Any numeric diffs in precomputed rotary tables?

lucas: dumped rotary cos/sin for layer 6 head 3 (first 64 dims) before and after conversion: diffs on some entries ~1e-2 which seems large.

ci-bot: quick eval started: run_eval --model kestrelx13b_int4 --task storybench --seq 2048 --runs 5

ci-bot: quick eval result: 4/5 runs show loop onset between 1180-1250 tokens. N-gram repetition detection flags returned high.

maya: tokenizer angle: unified-bpe maps soft-hyphen (U+00AD) to existing token id 432, while kestrel-spm had a dedicated id 7891. So unified-bpe aliases it.

frank: aliasing + small rotary table noise could let attention amplify that token repeatedly. Two experiments: (A) run int4 with rotary tables kept in fp32; (B) run with tokenizer remap that preserves soft-hyphen as separate id.

lucas: kicked both off. Commands:
```
# A: numeric-safe
python infra/run_infer.py --model kestrelx13b_int4 --rotary-table-fp32 --seq 2048
# B: keep tokenizer raw
python infra/run_infer.py --model kestrelx13b_int4 --tokenizer-override raw:keep_specials --seq 2048
```

ci-bot: run A done: loops disappeared in 5/5 quick runs, latency +4.8%.

ci-bot: run B done: loops still present but shifted later, onset ~1550. Token stream shows repeated 432 id but not exact phrase loop.

maya: sounds like numeric path is primary, token aliasing worsens it. For onboarding: we should (1) add a conversion check that ensures rotary table L2-diff < 1e-5, (2) keep soft-hyphen/ZWJ as dedicated ids in remapping, (3) add a longseq regression test to CI.

frank: additional note: quant packer currently compresses small scale constants aggressively. PR proposal: store per-head rotary scale as bf16 instead of int8-quant base; that should fix most drift with minimal size cost.

lucas: created issue #2119 and draft PR in bench repo for tests. I'll add a short doc blurb for release: KestrelX13B int4 long-context advisory: rotary constants retained higher-precision to avoid rare repetition under specific token aliasing.

maya: I'll follow up on tokenizer patch. tara: can you tag infra for a nightly longseq job once PR lands?

tara: will do. scheduling nightly run after merge. cc @product for advisory messaging. :thumbsup:
